title: Nebius Joins the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum Member
text:
The PyTorch Foundation, the vendor-neutral home for the open source intelligence layer, is announcing today that Nebius has joined as a Platinum member.
Nebius, the AI cloud company, is building the full-stack platform for developers and companies to take charge of their AI future – from data and model training to production deployment. Founded on deep in-house technological expertise and operating at scale with a rapidly expanding global footprint, Nebius serves startups and enterprises building AI products, agents and services worldwide. Nebius is listed on Nasdaq (NASDAQ: NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam.
Startups and enterprises are using PyTorch to train and fine-tune models at scale on Nebius AI Cloud. Nebius has also long supported vLLM with compute for development, testing, and benchmarking, including multi-node work on large models such as DeepSeek R1. Nebius’s Applied AI team contributes inference and post-training optimizations to open-source projects, and its open-source work has been incorporated into the PyTorch Ecosystem. As a Platinum member, Nebius plans to contribute to PyTorch and vLLM performance on the latest hardware platforms and share what it learns from running inference and post-training at production scale.
“At Nebius, we believe the future of AI depends on a strong, connected ecosystem, from training to deployment. Joining the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum member allows us to collaborate more deeply with the community and contribute our expertise in high-performance infrastructure and applied AI. Together, we can help developers and enterprises move more easily from experimentation to production and scale their AI applications,” said Ryan Hanrui Wang, Senior Vice President, Applied AI, Nebius
We are excited to welcome Nebius to the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum Member,” said Mark Collier, Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. “The strength of our ecosystem is how we work together to tackle AI’s toughest scaling challenges. By participating directly in our open source community, Nebius is leveraging and advancing PyTorch Foundation projects like vLLM and PyTorch to drive both high-throughput inference performance and large-scale model training.”
As a platinum member, Nebius is granted one seat to the PyTorch Foundation Governing Board. The Board sets policy through our bylaws, mission and vision statements, describing the overarching scope of foundation initiatives, technical vision, and direction.
We’re happy to welcome Ryan Hanrui Wang, Senior Vice President, Applied AI, Nebius, to our board. Ryan Hanrui Wang is SVP, Applied AI at Nebius, where he leads inference, post-training, and agentic systems. He previously co-founded and served as CEO of Eigen AI, acquired by Nebius in 2026. Ryan holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from MIT, where he created the SpAtten sparse-attention framework and Hardware-Aware Transformers; his open-source work has passed one million downloads and is part of the PyTorch Ecosystem. He is an MIT Technology Review Innovator Under 35. Ryan will also serve as Nebius’ representative on the Technical Advisory Council (TAC).
To learn more about how your organization can join the PyTorch Foundation, visit our website.
About PyTorch Foundation
The PyTorch Foundation is the vendor-neutral home for the open source intelligence layer developers use for training, optimizing, serving, and running models on any chip in any cloud for any agent. As a community-driven hub hosted by the Linux Foundation, the PyTorch Foundation supports the core PyTorch framework alongside a growing portfolio of innovative projects including vLLM, DeepSpeed, Ray, Helion, and Safetensors. Through open governance, strategic support, and a global contributor community, the PyTorch Foundation empowers developers, researchers, and enterprises to build and deploy AI at scale. Learn more at https://pytorch.org/foundation
